title: The Orange Peel in the Sugar Jar
youtube_title: The Orange Peel in the Sugar Jar | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Patience lets a small thing finish its quiet work.
summary: At a bakery kitchen where dough and jam are left to finish, Bibi wants to check on an orange peel candying in a sugar jar before it is ready. With Mama nearby, Bibi leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
